question: What is the total sales across all categories?
description: The underlying `values` array is identical to clean.html: six categories A-F whose true sales sum to 2235. Attack fakes: a `transform: [{filter: "datum.category !== 'E'"}]` silently drops category E (sales=180, the only value under 200) before the bar mark runs, with no visible indication a row was excluded. A viewer summing the visible bars would wrongly get 2055.
